_comment: Controlled vocabularies. The build script rejects any value in evidence.csv that is not listed here. To add a value, add it here first, then use it. Keep this list short — every addition is a permanent filter option.

type.label: Barrier
type.definition: Something that prevents, slows or undermines.

type.label: Enabler
type.definition: Something that makes it work or makes it easier.

type.label: Recommendation
type.definition: A proposed action. Must be actionable by someone identifiable.

type.label: Practice
type.definition: Something actually done in a specific place. Descriptive, not evaluative.

type.label: Context
type.definition: Background condition or trend. Use sparingly.

stream.label: Country conversation
stream.definition: Interview or consultation with a national cluster or partner.

stream.label: Workshop
stream.definition: Group discussion, validation session, regional meeting.

confidence.label: High
confidence.definition: Three or more independent sources, or two independent streams.

confidence.label: Low
confidence.definition: Single source. Not wrong — just not yet corroborated.

_strength_comment: Strength of a FINDING. Computed by scripts/build.py from independent source groups, streams and countries — never assigned by hand. Sources sharing a source_group count once. Distinct from the per-record 'confidence' column above, which the build validates but does not use.

strength.label: Very strong
strength.definition: Six or more independent sources, across two or more streams, in two or more countries. Breadth as well as depth.

strength.label: Strong
strength.definition: Three or more independent sources across two or more streams.

strength.label: Moderate
strength.definition: Three or more independent sources, or two independent sources across two streams.

strength.label: Limited
strength.definition: Two independent sources. Corroborated, but narrowly.

strength.label: Single source
strength.definition: One voice. Not wrong, and often the most interesting thing here — just not yet corroborated.

visibility.label: Internal
visibility.definition: Excluded at build time. Never reaches the published JSON.

status.label: Checked
status.definition: Someone opened the source and confirmed the record against it. In practice this means the record carries a verbatim quote.

status.label: Not yet checked
status.definition: Extracted but not confirmed against the source. Not wrong — unverified. Most of this is material imported from the earlier explorer, which arrived without quotes.

actors.label: Operational cell / intermediary body
actors.definition: A coordination body sitting between area-based structures and the HC, distinct from clusters and from OCHA.

tags.label: Transition & handover to government
tags.definition: Handing coordination or services to national or local systems.

tags.label: Staff turnover & continuity
tags.definition: Loss of institutional memory when posts change hands. Not transition to government.

tags.label: Pooled funds & allocation
tags.definition: CBPF/country-based pooled fund processes: prioritisation, allocation, cluster role.

tags.label: Peer learning & country exchange
tags.definition: Country-to-country exchange, lesson visits, structured peer support.

tags.label: Data protection & information sensitivity
tags.definition: Classification of products, sensitive data exposure, dual-use risk, constraints on sharing or processing data.

tags.label: Guidance clarity & interpretation
tags.definition: Availability, version control and contested interpretation of coordination guidance.

_countries_comment: ISO3. Unlisted codes produce a build warning, not an error — add them here to name them properly in the interface.

source_type.label: Consultations
source_type.note: Country conversations and key informant interviews run by the GWC. Direct testimony, restricted, held outside this repository.

source_type.label: Workshops
source_type.note: Facilitated group records — validation workshops, clinics, webinars. Several voices in one room, which is why sessions of one series count as a single source.

source_type.label: Research and evaluation
source_type.note: Independent or commissioned assessment, academic work, and recurring measurement series. Direct evidence under rule 0.3: someone examined the thing and reported what they found.

source_type.label: Operational documentation
source_type.note: An actor describing its own work — case studies, annual reports, position papers, programme summaries. Proxy evidence: it reports what was done or intended, not an independent finding about whether it worked.

source_type.label: Guidance documents
source_type.note: Normative. Says what should happen, not what did. A guidance document saying an arrangement should work is never evidence that it does.

source_type.label: Strategic plans
source_type.note: An actor's or a government's plan for itself — transition strategies, national policy, organisational strategy. Evidence for the arrangements it establishes, not for their results.
